content:
nina: running into a weird auth/retry loop in the next-edge starter when using LangChain connectors. after token refresh the embed step replays and we get a bunch of 401 -> retry -> 429 cycles.

hugo: dump the logs? is this serverless edge (Vercel edge fn) or node server?

nina: edge functions (Vercel) calling `@redwood/inference-js` from inside LangChain agent run. snippet below: 
```js
// edge handler
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
await chain.call({ input: 'summarize doc' }) // chain uses client inside an indexer step
```

nina: error flow: 1) request hits expiring API key, SDK tries to refresh token (internal refresh), 2) refresh returns 200 but then embed call from chain replays because it thinks the original failed, 3) two concurrent embed calls -> backend throttles -> 429s -> app-level retry -> duplicate index entries + doubled token usage.

sam: sounds similar to the idempotency double-send we saw, but here refresh dance plus immediate retry is the trigger. The JS SDK's auto-retry semantics differ from our python harness behavior.

aditya: can you paste a log excerpt? Also, do LangChain connectors have their own retry wrappers?

nina: pasted logs: 
```
2026-04-03T09:12:01.001Z WARN auth middleware token expired
2026-04-03T09:12:01.002Z INFO auth middleware refreshing token
2026-04-03T09:12:01.120Z INFO auth middleware refresh ok
2026-04-03T09:12:01.121Z INFO sdk retrying original request attempt=1
2026-04-03T09:12:01.121Z INFO chain indexer starting embed for doc=doc-42
2026-04-03T09:12:01.122Z INFO chain indexer starting embed for doc=doc-42 (duplicate)
2026-04-03T09:12:01.220Z ERROR backend embed status=429 body="Too Many Requests"
2026-04-03T09:12:01.221Z INFO chain will retry step attempt=1
```

hugo: aha. SDK retry is firing while LangChain/agent is also configured to retry steps on exceptions. Two-level retry.

aditya: root cause = non-idempotent embed + overlapping retry layers + immediate retry without jitter. Fix options: (A) SDK-level: expose opt-in idempotency headers + conservative backoff/jitter when refresh triggers; (B) Starter/connector: wrap embedding calls in a dedupe gate so concurrent identical inputs coalesce; (C) Docs: recommend a single retry policy surface (prefer SDK-managed or agent-managed but not both).

sam: for LangChain integrations we should ship sample code that shows the recommended pattern. e.g., `indexer.addDocuments(docs, { idempotencyKey: doc.id })` and set connector retry=0.

marta: for the Next.js starter, would a simple per-request mutex (in-memory) be enough? edge functions are stateless though. Could use local coalescing per invocation (dedupe promises) while running. Won't help cross-instance duplicates though.

aditya: agree. plan: 1) quick mitigation: SDK will add small jittered backoff when a token refresh occurs and avoid immediate replay (feature-flagged). 2) starter sample change: show `idempotencyKey` usage and set LangChain step retries=0 in the template. 3) longer-term: SDK supports idempotency header + server-side dedupe for embeddings within 5s window. 4) add CI smoke test to sample flows to detect >1.2x token usage.

nina: can someone own the starter PR? I can come up with the sample patch and docs note.

aditya: I'll own the SDK change. I'll add an opt-in env var `REDWOOD_SDK_REFRESH_BACKOFF=on` and document parity with python. Will also coordinate server-side dedupe ticket.

sam: heads-up for docs: update the quickstart troubleshooting section with a small LangChain example and explicit note about disabling agent-level retries for indexing steps.

ci-bot: ci/playwright-next-starter job failed earlier but new branch will trigger rerun once PRs open.

hugo: small nit: prefer `idempotency-key` header name `x-redwood-idempotency` to match other infra.

aditya: noted. will use `x-redwood-idempotency`.

marta: add a tiny e2e that runs the sample indexer with concurrent promises to validate only one embed request is sent (mock or recorded).

nina: i'll open PR for starter + sample code + test this afternoon. tagging @hugo for review.

aditya: I'll open SDK PR tomorrow GMT morning. adding migration note and changelog entry.

sam: thanks all. once both land let's rerun the playbook e2e and the cost smoke eval. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: created issue #4121 for server-side dedupe feature (queued)
